summary: Chunked buffer allocator, a structural twin of MemoryAllocatorWithChunking (005160ad) with element units scaled by 2^7 (128). Allocates a pointer-index array of a4 entries via MemoryAllocator, then fills it by allocating a4 buffers in bulk chunks through MemoryAllocatorWithAlignment, where each buffer is a3*128 bytes and each chunk holds at most v5 = min(0x3B9AC9F0 / (a3 << 7), a4) buffers. The chunk size is stored at this+0x50 and the final chunk is capped to the remaining count. A buffer size larger than the 0x3B9AC9F0 ceiling triggers the error path: constant 69 at obj+0x14 and a vtable dispatch through *a1. Returns the pointer-index array.

operations.description: Cache the base pointer from this+0x4 (a1[1]) into v4
Compute the max possible chunk as v5 = 0x3B9AC9F0 / (a3 << 7) (buffers per chunk, each buffer a3*128 bytes, bounded by the allocator's 1,000,000,000-byte ceiling)

When 0x3B9AC9F0 / (a3 << 7) <= 0 (buffer size exceeds the allocation ceiling): write constant 69 at obj+0x14 and dispatch the error handler through the object vtable at obj+0x0 (read as *a1), passing a1
Cap the chunk size: when v5 >= a4, set v5 = a4 so a single chunk covers the whole request
Store the computed chunk size v5 at v4 + 76 (this+0x4 + 76 = this+0x50)
Allocate the pointer-index array v11 = MemoryAllocator(a1, a2, 4 * a4)
Fill loop over v7 < a4; when v5 >= a4 - v7 the last chunk is capped to the remaining count
Allocate a chunk of v5 buffers: v8 = MemoryAllocatorWithAlignment(a1, a2, (a3 * v5) << 7)
Inner fill loop: store the current buffer pointer into the index array (v11 + 4*v7), advance v8 by 32 * a3 (a3*128 bytes), increment v7, repeat v9 times (v9 = v5)
Return the pointer-index array v11; consumed by DirectXTextureSurfaceAllocation (0051629f)
